rules.title: No Synthetic Historical L2 Depth
rules.requirement: Gate G1 remains fail-closed until continuous verified L2 order-book tapes with tape_manifest_sha256 exist.

rules.title: No Fabricated Maker Fills
rules.requirement: Synthetic or predefined historical maker fills are permanently banned under WP-8S; OBSERVATIONS_ONLY candidates cannot enter Resting.

rules.title: Point-in-Time Evidence Cutoff
rules.requirement: evidence_max_ts_utc <= pit_cutoff_utc < event_blackout_utc enforced fail-closed; zero lookahead leakage.

rules.title: Conditional EV Non-Double-Counting
rules.requirement: Exact 1/10,000-cent check: fill_conditioned_win_bps * 100 - (price + fee) * 10000 > 0 with fill_conditioned_win_bps <= model_prob_bps; maker rebates excluded conservatively.

rules.title: Positive Net Edge Hurdle
rules.requirement: Candidates with conditional_ev_cents < 1 or non-positive exact EV are rejected fail-closed.

rules.title: Finite Order Lifecycle
rules.requirement: States restricted to Candidate -> Prepared -> Resting -> Filled/Cancelled/Raced -> Settled -> Ledger; Filled covers any closed order with >= 1 fill (full or partial); multi-fills log via g2_fill_event.

rules.title: No Skipped or Backward Transitions
rules.requirement: Only oneOf-enumerated directed acyclic transitions (including Candidate/Prepared -> Cancelled) with gapless transition_seq are legal.

rules.title: Terminal State Immutability
rules.requirement: Ledger, Cancelled (filled_qty == 0), and Raced (filled_qty == 0) are immutable terminal states.

rules.title: Overfill Cap Enforcement
rules.requirement: Sum of idempotent g2_fill_event quantities must never exceed immutable reserved_qty; duplicate fill_id rejected.

rules.title: Pre-Event Calendar Blackouts
rules.requirement: Calendar-driven quote cancellations replace sub-millisecond HFT race simulations; partially filled orders close to Filled -> Settled -> Ledger.

rules.title: Strategy D Passive Maker Posture
rules.requirement: Maker limit orders serve strictly as fee-avoidance tactics, never speculative latency chasing.

rules.title: ADR-008 Integer-Cent Conservation
rules.requirement: All monetary amounts are JS-safe 64-bit integer cents; floats rejected at JSON parse time.

rules.title: ADR-012 High-Water Mark 87/10/3 Waterfall
rules.requirement: 87% SCMA / 3% FAEP floor-truncated and 10% + residual (0..2 cents, informational inside cfcp_allocation_cents) apply strictly to positive HWM-eligible profit above each SCMA's prior High-Water Mark.

rules.title: 100% SCMA Loss Isolation (Ratified via Erratum)
rules.requirement: 100% of trading losses remain isolated in the executing SCMA; CFCP and FAEP never absorb losses; waterfall raises ValueError if invoked on P <= 0.

rules.title: 40% Dry-Powder Cash Floor
rules.requirement: Unreserved liquid cash must remain >= max(4000, ceil(0.40 * equity)) in integer arithmetic, checked post-reservation.

rules.title: Quarter-Kelly Ceiling
rules.requirement: Single-trade max loss qty * (price + fee) <= min(0.25*Kelly(fill_conditioned_win_bps), floor(0.02 * equity)).

rules.title: Downward-Only Member Risk Dial
rules.requirement: Members may lower risk autonomously; upward restoration requires F2-H custodian approval.

rules.title: N=12 Concurrency & Priority Eviction
rules.requirement: Active admitted slots are capped at N=12 with deterministic rank-based eviction.

rules.title: Cross-Account Contract Mutex
rules.requirement: ContractMutexRegistry enforces anti-collusion domain/contract locks per CFTC Rule 150.4.

rules.title: $25k Active Float Ceiling Sweep
rules.requirement: Custodial balances above 2,500,000 cents stage signed IF-038 outbox sweeps.

rules.title: ADR-011 Air-Gapped Banking Boundary
rules.requirement: Zero bank account numbers, routing numbers, or plaintext venue secrets stored on disk.

rules.title: Signed Monotonic Outbox Sequencing
rules.requirement: Every settlement ledger entry carries gapless monotonic outbox_sequence_id, key_id, and 64-hex hmac_sha256.

rules.title: Directive R-06 Active-Hat Siloing
rules.requirement: Role tokens are strictly siloed; cross-role endpoint access fails closed with HTTP 403.

rules.title: Directive R-12 Telemetry Redaction
rules.requirement: Technical console masks financial fields by default until an expiring CA grant is active.

rules.title: Directive R-15 Distribution Gateway
rules.requirement: Green is autonomous, Yellow adds friction, Red enforces 24-hour lock and dual F2-H co-signing.

rules.title: Directive R-04 Fail-Closed Emergency Halt
rules.requirement: Emergency kill-switch halts new commitments immediately; AI never executes unilaterally.
